name: LLMs & Agents
blurb: Short videos only: every pick is 20 minutes or less and covers one or two ideas, ordered as a sequence. Subtopics follow the LLMs and Agents guides in Topics.
method:
• Length: hard cap of 20 minutes per video; depth comes from a sequence.
  • Order: picks in a subtopic are in watching order; the first is the starting point.
  • Sources: there is no single short course here, so picks come from the clearest explainer per concept: AI Coffee Break, Efficient NLP, StatQuest, IBM Technology, DataMListic and the original authors where they explain their own work.
  • This field moves fast; check the upload date before trusting tool-specific details.
